peer_review_model.notes: Single-anonymized is the default, but double-anonymized is an option for some Nature-branded and Communications journals.

ai_use_policy.value: Peer reviewers are asked not to upload manuscripts into generative AI tools. If any part of the evaluation was supported by an AI tool, reviewers must declare this transparently.

remarks: The page focuses on peer review policies and does not provide submission guidelines for specific article types.
